description:
Operation IDs listed here or in receipts are names only. Before the first call to each operation in this conversation, call elevenlabs_discover_api with that operation_id to read its contract, unless a tool description or receipt already supplies the exact parameter names and locations. Never infer path_params, query_params or body fields from an operation name.
Create admitted resources or issue client connection credentials using an admitted operation_id.
WHEN TO USE: create a new resource or explicitly request a signed connection URL, WebRTC token or ephemeral realtime credential. Credentials are returned to the assistant; the host may retain them in the conversation. Prefer get_conversation_signed_link over its deprecated underscore route. URL document creation asks the provider to fetch the URL. Local document operands belong only in files, never hidden body paths. Inspect the contract before creating; no retry or polling is automatic. After a successful create, do the read named in the receipt's next_step before using the new resource elsewhere.
RELATED TOOLS: elevenlabs_discover_api, elevenlabs_read_resource, elevenlabs_change_resource.
EXAMPLE: {"operation_id":"create_text_document_route","body":{"name":"Guide","text":"Acme guide text"}}
COST: creation or indexing may consume credits.

body.description: The provider request body for this operation, preserving its schema, arrays and nulls. Omit for bodyless operations; local file operands belong in files.

path_params.description: Declared path parameter names and nonempty string values; inspect this operation with elevenlabs_discover_api.

query_params.description: Declared query parameter names with string, number, boolean, null or scalar-array values. Arrays repeat; null is omitted.

name: elevenlabs_create_resource
